newsitem.title: EU: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ C 307 OF OCTOBER 16, 1996.
newsitem.headline: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ C 307 OF OCTOBER 16, 1996.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)
Amendment to the notice of invitation to tender for the refund for the export of oats to all third countries (96/C 307/11)

Proposal for a European Parliament and Council Directive amending for the third time Directive 83/189/EEC laying down a procedure for the provision of information in the field of technical standards and regulations (96/C 307/10) (Text with EEA relevance) COM(96) 392 final - 96/0220(COD)
Proposal for a European Parliament and Council Directive on the sale of consumer goods and associated guarantees (96/C 307/09) (Text with EEA relevance) COM(95) 520 final - 96/0161(COD)

Recapitulation of current tenders, published in the Supplement to the Official Journal of the European Communities, financed by the European Community under the European Development Fund (EDF) or the European Communities budget (week: 8 to 12 October 1996) (96/C 307/08)
Authorization for State aid pursuant to Articles 92 and 93 of the EC Treaty Cases where the Commission raises no objections (96/C 307/07)
Inapplicability of the Regulation to a notified operation (Case No IV/M.777 - AGF/Camat) (96/C 307/06)
Non-opposition to a notified concentration (Case No IV/M.796 - InfraLeuna) (96/C 307/05)

NOTICE Appeal for information concerning the effects on Community enterprises of the Cuban Liberty and Democratic Solidarity (Libertad) Act 1996 of the United States of America (USA) and of other measures taken by the USA affecting trade with Cuba (96/C 307/04)
